zubin

zubin reads and writes structured binary data in R: describe a fixed binary record once, as a layout, and read or write millions of them in one call; convert typed vectors to and from bytes at any width and byte order; append to a growable byte buffer that is not quadratic. The same machinery is a header-only C library that other packages use through LinkingTo.

zubin is under development towards its first release; nothing is exported yet.

Installation

You can install the development version of zubin from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zubin")
